desc: Trading Members of the Exchange are hereby informed that effective from August 31, 2026, the Equity Shares of Augmont Enterprises Ltd (Scrip Code: 544888) are listed and admitted to dealings on the Exchange in the list of ''B'' Group Securities. For further details please refer to the notice no 20260828- dated August 28, 2026.

Intimation for Closure of Trading Window with effect from 1st September 2026 and shall re-open after 48 hours from the announcement of the unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June 2026. Under SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 ('PIT Regulations).
